messages:
deploy-bot: Preflight: starting canary rollout for release v3.17 -> canary-us, change window 2026-04-02 14:00-15:00 UTC. Group=3. Release notes: https://internal.redwood.dev/releases/v3.17
anna: Quick preflight check  who is rollback owner and where's the backout/runbook? Also share pin command so we have it ready.
rafael: Backout runbook: https://confluence.redwood.dev/display/OPS/Backout-v3.17. I'll own rollback for canary.
ops-bot: Ops pin command (ops-runner): `rdeploy pin --cluster canary --image redwood:v3.17 --duration 45m --reason "canary hold"`. Hotpin threshold: p95 > 220ms sustained 3m. Use full rollback if 5xx >0.7% or DB schema errors.
anna: Thanks. Please paste a 1-line rollback checklist here for the channel (so oncall has it).
rafael: Rollback checklist (TL;DR): 1) `rdeploy rollback --to-tag redwood:v3.16 --cluster canary` 2) `kubectl rollout restart deployment/edge-proxy -n redwood` 3) flush canary caches `redis-cli -h cache.canary FLUSHDB` 4) check `kubectl logs -n redwood -l app=worker | grep -i schema` 5) reopen change window + notify product.
oncall-bot: Rollback owner assigned: rafael. Pager: +1-555-0210. Escalation path: oncall -> eng-sre -> eng-platform.
deploy-bot: Canary progress update: 1/3 OK, 2/3 degraded (p95=240ms) -> auto-pause triggered by rule `p95 > 220ms`.
anna: Auto-pause seen. Rafael, go ahead with rollback checklist. If traffic bleeds to stable, we may pin stable.
rafael: Executing step 1 now: `rdeploy rollback --to-tag redwood:v3.16 --cluster canary`
ops-bot: Rollback completed by rafael at 2026-04-02T14:07:30Z. Health checks: p95=90ms, errors <0.1%. Recommend 10m watch.
product-bot: Product notified and drafting rollback blurb for the release page. Will update release notes link once ready.
anna: Great. Add a short postmortem to the release ticket and schedule a 30m retro. Thanks all.
